sources.exact_excerpt:
The type of module package identifiers.

This is a {name}`String` that is used to disambiguate native symbol prefixes between
different packages (and different versions of the same package).
-/
abbrev PkgId := String

/-- A module's setup information as described by a JSON file. -/
structure ModuleSetup where
  /-- The name of the module. -/
  name : Name
  /-- The package to which the module belongs (if any). -/
  package? : Option PkgId := none

instance [Hashable α] : Hashable (Option α) where
  hash
    | none   => 11
    | some a => mixHash (hash a) 13

/-- Hash of a value using its `Hashable` instance. -/
@[inline] public def ofHashable [Hashable α] (a : α) : Hash :=
  mix nil <| mk <| hash a -- same as Name.mkSimple

diagnosis: Package.id? is Option PkgId, and PkgId is String, while Module.name is Name. The old package-name expression incorrectly inserted Name.anonymous mixing before Option.some hashing.
